motion.name: ease

components.name: Button
components.description: Default action; inverts to ink on hover.

components.name: Segmented Tabs

components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #1c2a22; border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg button { appearance: none; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #1c2a22; background: transparent; color: #1c2a22; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; font: 600 0.9375rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true] { background: #2d6cdf; color: #fff; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2d6cdf; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Rail Job
components.description: Numbered job in the dark rail; the current job inverts to sheet stock.
components.css: .ds-rail { background: #1c2a22; padding: 16px 12px; display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 168px; } .ds-job { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr; gap: 8px; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 12px 8px; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font: 500 1.0625rem/1.2 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #e3eee0; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-job:hover { background: #2a3e32; } .ds-job:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9fc3ff; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-job[aria-current=page] { background: #d9e8d6; color: #1c2a22; font-weight: 700; } .ds-n { font: 500 0.9375rem/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; color: #a9bfaa; } .ds-job[aria-current=page] .ds-n { color: #1d54c0; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat bordered raised-sheet container with a section heading.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #e8f1e5; border: 1px solid #8fa690; border-radius: 3px; padding: 12px 16px; color: #1c2a22; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.45 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 700 1.0625rem/1.2 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px 12px; margin: 0; } .ds-stats dt { color: #3a4e41; } .ds-stats dd { margin: 0; text-align: right; font: 500 1.0625rem/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; }

components.css: .ds-sheetwrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid #8fa690; background: #e8f1e5; color: #1c2a22; } .ds-sheet { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.45 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-sheet th, .ds-sheet td { padding: 8px 10px; text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,42,34,0.22); border-right: 1px solid rgba(28,42,34,0.22); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-sheet thead th { font: 700 1.0625rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; background: #d9e8d6; } .ds-sheet th[scope=row] { text-align: left; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.2 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3a4e41; background: #d9e8d6; border-right: 1px solid #3a4e41; } .ds-sheet td.sel, .ds-sheet thead th.sel { background: #c9dcf5; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 #2d6cdf; } .ds-num { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-weight: 500; } .ds-pencil { display: inline-block; border: 2px solid #c4352a; border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 10px; color: #a42a20; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Gizpix looks like the timing sheet an animator keeps beside the light table. Frames are columns with their numbers above them. A checker's pencil does the marking: blue for the frame you are on, red for the frame that needs a look. The screen sits on pale green sheet stock, with a deep green-grey rail down the left edge for the four jobs. Everything else is hairline ruling, plain type and the user's own pixels.

The mood is calm, exact and a little stationery-like. It is dense enough to show eight frames and their numbers without scrolling, and quiet enough that the 3x sprite previews carry the page. The build rejects the category-default tool shell (grey sidebar, floating cards, a single blue accent on white). The only ornament is the sheet tint itself.
keyCharacteristics: Pale green sheet ground and a dark green rail, light theme only (`color-scheme: light`).
Frames as table columns; every job reuses the sheet: Clean shows repair counts, Cut shows layer pixels and "Look at", Recolour shows before/after columns.
Two pencils only. Blue means selection, focus and the primary action. Red means a mark or warning and nothing else.
Condensed grotesque for heads, labels and column numbers; plain sans for reading; mono for numbers and commands.
Flat. Hairline 1px rules and tonal steps do all the depth work.
Previews are real pixels: nearest-neighbour, whole-number zoom, never resampled.

rules.name: The Two Pencils Rule
rules.body: Blue marks where you are and what you can do; red marks what is wrong. Neither colours a surface decoratively, and neither is ever the only signal: the red oval carries the words "Needs a look" and the blue column carries the frame number.

rules.name: The Green Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted toward the sheet green. A grey or pure white surface is off-system; the field white (#f6faf4) is the lightest value.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Counts, frame indices and commands are mono; labels for them are condensed. A number in the body sans is a slip.

rules.name: The Heading Is A Heading Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked condensed type is used only on real section, subsection and row headings. It is not a decorative label above other headings.

rules.name: The Whole-Zoom Rule
rules.body: Sprites are shown at integer zoom, `image-rendering: pixelated`, with no resampling. Sheet thumbnails are cropped to the content box at true size.

rules.name: The Flat-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A new surface is a bordered, tinted rectangle, never a shadowed card or a modal; even the folder picker opens inline.

dos: Do use Blue Pencil (#2d6cdf) only for selection, focus, the one primary action and checked controls.
Do mark a frame that needs attention with the red oval plus words; keep red for marks and warnings.
Do show every preview as true pixels at integer zoom on Plate Green, and pair it with measured counts in mono.
Do build new results as columns in the exposure sheet with named row heads before inventing a new layout.
Do keep depth to tone and 1px rules; open pickers and details inline.
Do give every control a visible 2px blue focus ring and a 40px (or 32px small) target.
Do keep all UI text in strings.js and the three fonts self-hosted.
donts: Don't use a grey or white neutral, a drop shadow, a modal, or a floating card; the world is flat green sheet stock.
Don't use red decoratively, or as the only signal of a problem.
Don't resample, smooth or fractionally scale a sprite preview.
Don't use the red oval as a generic tag or pill, or add pills elsewhere.
Don't set a number in the body sans, or set a decorative uppercase label above a heading.
Don't claim a result is perfect; show the limit in a notice where the user decides.
